fields.Name: ORD-04 - Payments and Rollups
fields.Description: The money-in half: rollup TRIGGERS, document numbering, and instrument handling (PR1-PR9, D30/D39/D42). Order totals roll up from lines; payments roll into AmountPaid/Balance/PaymentStatus across Unpaid -> PartiallyPaid -> Paid; a captured PaymentDetail is immutable at the database level; OrderNumber and PaymentNumber are auto-assigned and unique; and the D42 initial-payment intent becomes a real fully-applied payment whose instrument is a COPY, never the order's row.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 250 order reads Unpaid then PartiallyPaid at 100 then Paid at 250; tampering with a captured instrument is refused; ORD-/PAY- numbers match {6 digits}; the auto payment settles the order and carries its own PaymentDetail.
